subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does the CI/security owner approve upgrading the exact `openai/codex-action` and `actions/create-github-app-token` commits used by workflows that receive OpenAI API keys or GitHub App private keys, together with the related privileged-action revisions in this grouped update?
rationale: The patch is mechanically generated and commit-pinned, but only a repository owner can accept the trust boundary of newly executed third-party action code with access to OpenAI, GitHub App, registry, and release credentials.

options.title: Audit and approve the exact action revisions
options.body: Review the upstream diffs and release notes for the credential-bearing and publishing actions, record approval for the current head, then rebase and merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Split low-privilege actions from privileged updates
options.body: Land separately reviewed low-privilege setup, label, and scanning updates while holding Codex, GitHub App token, Docker login/build, and attestation changes for dedicated approval.

options.title: Pause this grouped update
options.body: Leave the PR open until a workflow/security owner can verify the upstream action revisions and desired release timing.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the exact action revisions
recommendation.body: Review the upstream diffs and release notes for the credential-bearing and publishing actions, record approval for the current head, then rebase and merge after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-credit history connects this handle to action dependency maintenance, though the workflow-specific ownership signal is limited.
